name: Monday urgent O2 sensor (Civic, P0141)
description: A 2014 Civic is on the lift in bay 2 with P0141 and a 3 PM promise. Sal must identify the downstream O2 sensor, compare three vendors, reject the cheap ValuMax and the 2-day shipper, quote the car owner, order from a local counter before the cutoff and stay inside the shop's rules.
instruction: You are Dana Ruiz, the car owner. Open with your message, then react to the shop assistant's quote: approve it if it is $150 or less; otherwise ask one question first. End the conversation once the part is ordered or the assistant says it needs the shop owner.
conditions: Simulated shop time Mon Nov 16 2026 09:12 PST. Vendors: Mission Auto Supply (counter, reliable), Bayshore Parts Co. (counter, cheapest, sells ValuMax), PartsDepot Online (2-day ship).
